reviewer: checkpoint_formal, independent of the manuscript and assessment authors
scope: Publication-claim consistency audit against the frozen accepted research source and review record. Not a new proof, mathematical search, certificate replay, Lean compilation, PDF visual audit or deployment verification.
checks: Uniform gap ceiling is four throughout the feasible domain, not two or zero
All-even-width two-day refinement retains w>=64; odd-width two-day refinement retains w=2b+1>=65, even n>=w, k>=2b
Widths<=64 retain prior three-day coverage and all stronger intersections; odd-by-odd exact evaluator is credited as prior work
Exact even transport family retains b>=32, d=1 all lengths, or 2<=d<=b-1 with n>=2b+2d-2
Exact odd/even family retains d>=1, b>=4d+8 and (2b+1)(ell-b)>2d^2; minimum-budget consequence is odd w>=25 and even n>=w
Actual-span criterion retains G=max(abs(D),abs(1-D)) at genuine capped entry; G<=3 is sufficient but not universal
P recurrence, common-cut slack inequalities and final-inspection offset agree with accepted source statements
J endpoint minimization and minimizer selection precede physical construction; no optimization-free parameter rule or O(1) numerical claim
Static even critical-set geometry retains its cardinality/surplus hypotheses and is not a dynamic optimality theorem
Symbolic candidate is separate, with pending independent replay and physical-interface checks; excluded budgets d=b-2,b-1 are not promoted
Conditional 17/16 inequality and unreviewed square separator do not supply an accepted capture-time result
Formal coverage remains source-identical historical Lean evidence, with no new complete physical-game October theorem
Frozen RESULTS artifact-status paragraph is explicitly identified as pre-publication status in evidence guide

Added precise static critical-set surplus and cardinality hypotheses
Explicitly distinguished J-minimizer strategy construction from an optimization-free parameter rule
